tom_sales: Quick heads up  prospect (GreenBridge) needs SOC2 Type II (redacted ok), ISO27001 certificate, and a short pen-test attestation for their vendor security review. Deadline next Thu. Also asked if sharing this changes the POC price. cc @anya_se @rachel_security @sara_legal

anya_se: POC is on our hosted sandbox; sharing redacted artifacts for evaluation should not change the quoted POC fees. Dedicated or on-prem changes would be quoted separately.

rachel_security: We can prepare a redacted SOC2 attestation page, ISO cert, and a one-page pen-test attestation noting scope and test date. We DO NOT share raw findings or scan data without a signed NDA + internal approval. ETA to assemble signed pack: ~48 hours after I pull the latest vendor letter.

sara_legal: Confirmed. I'll attach our standard one-way NDA and a permitted-use paragraph limiting redistribution. If they demand full findings, we require a completed request form + exec sign-off. I'll add a short cover letter template too.

tom_sales: They also want a single procurement-safe sentence to paste: "no change to POC fees for evidence sharing"  can someone propose final text?

anya_se: How about: "Sharing redacted compliance artifacts for vendor evaluation will not change the quoted POC fees; infrastructure or support changes may be quoted separately."

sara_legal: That works. Short version approved: "Providing redacted compliance artifacts will not change POC fees."

rachel_security: Plan to include these files in the pack and upload to secure storage once ready:
```
- SOC2-Redacted-Attestation-2024.pdf
- ISO27001-Certificate.pdf
- PenTest-Attestation-Rachel-signed.pdf
- POC-Sanitized-Architecture.pdf
- Evidence-Cover-Letter.pdf
```
I'll add a short one-page summary describing what "redacted" means (controls only, no internal ticket IDs, no vuln details).

vault_bot: Pre-upload check OK. Upload will be to gs://redwood-evidence/due-diligence/1778001023/ (access: sales,se,security,legal).

rachel_security: Uploaded and set ACL to sales+legal+security. Link sent to @tom_sales. Marked ready pending NDA for pen-test attestation.

tom_sales: Sent to customer procurement. They confirmed receipt, will sign NDA tonight, and asked for the one-line procurement statement in their form. I pasted: "Providing redacted compliance artifacts will not change POC fees." They accepted it. Closing this loop  thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
